content:
Today, Apple TV released a trailer for the fifth season of its award-winning children's mindfulness animated series <em>Stillwater</em>. You can watch it below.

<em>Stillwater</em> returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for <em>Stillwater</em> season five, with all five episodes landing on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of <em>Stillwater</em> will add more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday rituals," continuing to help children and families find inner calm.

<em>Stillwater</em> originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and went on to win a Daytime Emmy in the Preschool Animation category, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth Programming category.
